summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K furnishing an intimation under SEBI Regulation 30 disclosing its schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings, equivalent to a US investor-conference notice on Form 8-K. Management will attend an ICICI Securities group meet in Hyderabad on September 17, 2026 and a Bank of America virtual group meet on September 24, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is a routine disclosure with no special-situation or risk-arb angle; watch only for any guidance or deal commentary that may emerge at the meetings.
